Tooltip_RemoteDoorOpener: A handmade electronic remote. Install it on an unlocked garage door or fence gate with "Install Auto Door Opener", keep it in your inventory and press the key while seated in a vehicle to open or close your doors without getting out. The remote only automates the open/close action and never bypasses locks.
IGUI_AutoDoor_NeedRemote: A remote control is required in your inventory
IGUI_AutoDoor_CannotInstallLocked: Cannot install on a locked door (unlock it first)
IGUI_AutoDoor_NoDoorInRange: No paired auto door in range
